name: CCNA 200-301
tagline: Pass Cisco's CCNA exam and configure real networks.
description: Every topic on Cisco's official CCNA 200-301 exam blueprint, in the order that builds on itself: how networks move data, switching, routing, services, security and automation. Lessons are grounded in the Official Cert Guide, every configuration topic has a graded Cisco console lab, and timed practice exams mix questions from all six domains like the real test.
outcome: You can design an addressing plan, configure and troubleshoot switches and routers from the CLI, explain every exam topic in your own words, and score at least 85% on timed practice exams.

stages.title: Network Fundamentals
stages.summary: What networks are made of, how data is packaged and moved, IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnetting, switching and wireless basics.
stages.milestone: Subnet any address in under a minute and explain how a frame crosses a switch.

stages.title: Network Access
stages.summary: VLANs, trunks, discovery protocols, EtherChannel, spanning tree, wireless architectures and device management.
stages.milestone: Build a multi-switch LAN with VLANs, trunks and EtherChannel, and predict the spanning tree.

stages.title: IP Connectivity
stages.summary: The routing table, static routes, inter-VLAN routing, single-area OSPF and first hop redundancy.
stages.milestone: Route between sites with static routes and OSPF, and read any routing table.

stages.title: IP Services
stages.summary: NAT and PAT, DHCP and DNS, NTP, SNMP, syslog, QoS, SSH and file transfer.
stages.milestone: Give a branch office internet access through PAT, DHCP for its hosts and secure management.

stages.title: Security Fundamentals
stages.summary: Threats and defenses, device hardening, AAA, VPNs, access control lists, Layer 2 security and wireless security.
stages.milestone: Lock down a switch and router, and write ACLs that enforce a policy on the first try.

stages.title: Automation and Programmability
stages.summary: Controller-based networking, SDN, REST APIs, JSON, configuration management tools and AI in network operations.
stages.milestone: Read a controller's API response and explain how automation changes network operations.

stages.title: Exam readiness
stages.summary: Bring the six domains together: troubleshoot across layers from show output, build complete devices from a blank config, and plan the last weeks and exam day.
stages.milestone: Pass both capstone labs from memory and score 85% or more on two practice exams in a row.

exam.title: CCNA practice exam
exam.note: Cisco does not publish the passing score. Aim for 85% or more on these practice exams before you book the real one.
